response.http_code_semantics: 503 Service Unavailable — the canonical 'NOT READY' contract. Per Kubernetes-style readiness probes, this means the pod is NOT eligible to receive traffic until the failures are resolved. PipelineGen mirrors this contract; a 200 from /ready means all subsystems report ok=true.
response.body_verbatim: {"checks":{"db":{"duration_ms":0,"ok":true},"drive":{"applicable":false,"duration_ms":0,"note":"drive checker not wired","ok":true},"jobs":{"duration_ms":0,"error":"runner liveness probe failed: broker heartbeat stale: last heartbeat 9223372036854775807 seconds ago (threshold 60s)","ok":false,"running_jobs":0},"qdrant":{"configured":true,"duration_ms":2,"ok":true}},"ok":false,"status":"not ready"}

jobs.error: runner liveness probe failed: broker heartbeat stale: last heartbeat 9223372036854775807 seconds ago (threshold 60s)

response._drift_source_of_truth: /ready is the canonical Gin-root-anchored diagnostics endpoint (not /api/diagnostics per user spec). The handler emits a checks envelope with per-subsystem ok/err/duration_ms/error fields; top-level ok=false aggregates any check failure.

subsystem_status.db: ok=true — SQLite reachable from inside the process
subsystem_status.drive: applicable=false, ok=true — drive checker NOT wired in this deployment. The 'applicable' field means the subsystem check CORRECTLY reports inapplicability rather than failing; this is a godlike/07 honest no-fake-availability contract — the checker refuses to report checked when it cannot be checked.
subsystem_status.jobs: ok=false — runner liveness probe failed. The error is 'broker heartbeat stale: last heartbeat 9223372036854775807 seconds ago' (the threshold is 60s). This means the jobs broker heartbeat telemetry is reporting a sentinel value (max int64 = 9223372036854775807 ns ≈ never-set). Either (a) no worker has been alive long enough to register a heartbeat, (b) the heartbeat writer is gated off in this deployment, or (c) the heartbeat storage is empty post-migration. THIS IS THE BLOCKER for FASE 2-7 (job lifecycle probes).
subsystem_status.qdrant: ok=true, configured=true — Qdrant reachable on this stack. Confirms user's Qdrant-reachable assumption (NOT a surprise).

_diagnostic_summary.user_expectation_vs_reality: User spec assumed Qdrant + Drive both reachable. Real state: Qdrant ok, Drive applicable=false (not wired), jobs ok=false (heartbeat stale).
